_doc: Hero camera keyframes, read by site/js/hero3d.js from hero.json (build-hero.mjs copies this block there).
Angles in degrees: azimuth is the camera's direction from its target (0 = +x, 90 = +y), elevation is above the table.
Distances in mm; times in seconds of the cinematic clock, which pauses while the hero is off screen.
startClock: where the trains' timetable (period 79.5 s) starts, so the Emerald Night crosses the viaduct in front of the opening shot.
opening: the first frame and the poster, held for `hold` s. pullBack: seconds of the eased move to the whole-layout view.
full: the whole layout, every vertex inside `margin` [x, y] of the frame (shares of half its width and height) at every sway angle.
sway: a gentle orbit `degrees` either side of full.azimuth, `period` s per cycle.

follow: at least `every` s apart, when all of train `train` (index in hero.json trains) stays above `minHeight` for the whole move, push in over `in` s, ride along for `hold` s and pull out over `out` s.
resume: after `after` s without a drag or pinch, blend back into the cinematic over `blend` s, longer if needed so the view turns no faster than `maxTurn` degrees a second.
